page.layout: One page of text in a single column of verse, with a heading "Cyclades insulæ." set above the verse; marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they stand against. Running head "MARE ÆGÆVM" at top; page number 307 at top right.

p.i: —tempúsque fuit, quo nauit in undis,
Nunc sedet Orthygie.
Hinc Humilem Myconem, cretosáq; ruraCimoli,
Florentem Cythnon, Cypron, planámque Seriphon,
Marmoreamq; Paron, quamq; impia prodidit Arne
Sitonis accepto, quod aurea poposcerat, auro:
Mutata est in nauem, qua nunc quoque diligit aurum,
Nigrapedes, nigris velata monedula pennis.
At non Oliaros, Didyméque, & Tenos, & Andros,
Et Gyaros nividaq; fitrax Peparethos olina,
Gnosiacas innere rares.
Cycladesipsa tua Myconè Gyaróque reuelli
Dele times, magniquefidem restaris alumni.
Iam Samos à laua fuerat, Naxósque relicta,
Et Paros, & Clario Delos amata Deo.
Dextra Lebynthos erat syluísque umbrosa Pachynne,
Cunctaq; psicosis Astypalaea vadis.
Quód facerem versus inter fera murmura Ponti
Cycladas Ægæas obstupuisse puto.
Interfusa nitentes
Vites aquora Cycladas.
Linquimus Orthygia portus, pelagóque volamus,
Bacchatamq; iugis Naxon, viridémq; Donysam,
Oleacon, niueamq; Paron, sparsasq; per aquor
Cycladas.
Sera tamen Mundo venerunt astra, sed illis
Vt Paros, & nemorosa Thasos, crebraq; relucent
Cyclades, vna grauí penitus latet obruta cælo
Lemnos, in hac tristes nebula, & plaga caca superne
Texitur vna vagis Lemnos non agnita nautis
Iamq; per Ægaos ibat Laertia fluctus

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are small and partly damaged; readings of several island names and the mid-verse notes are uncertain. Notes are placed at the approximate lines they stand against. The verse is printed with long-s and ligature forms that have been normalised. Some letters in "Cimolus", "Didyme", "Olearos" and "Peparethos" are doubtful.
